vulnerability.explanation: If an input COFF file contains an unsupported/unknown relocation type, rtype2howto() sets the arelent->howto field to NULL (lines 261-270). Later, extra_case() unconditionally uses reloc->howto, first passing it to bfd_get_reloc_size() at line 344 and then switching on reloc->howto->type (line 357), causing a NULL pointer dereference. An attacker can trigger this by supplying a COFF object with an unrecognized relocation type.
